findings.observation: FY2027/3 Q1 actual covers2026-04-01–06-30; priorQ1 is2025-04-01–06-30. Annual issuer plan covers2026-04-01–2027-03-31. The statement is JapanGAAP consolidated, while its reference individual figures and supplement sections are separate. Supplementphysical3/printed1 is consolidated; physical4/printed2 and orders/individualfinancials onphysical5–8 are standalone.
findings.interpretation_limit: Do not compare Q1 actual to previous full-year actual as sameperiod, annualizeQ1, or combine individual/consolidated profits just because the same forecastEPS appears.

findings.observation: Reportsegments changed from3to5: investmentdevelopment split into realestate/infrastructureoperation; machinery moved outofOther. PriorQ1 segment data is recast to the new basis. The supplement PL heading不動産事業等 is a renamed aggregate reportingline, not the新5区分の不動産事業 alone.
findings.interpretation_limit: Use the recast comparison and distinguish externalcustomer sales from segmentinternal sales, grossprofit from segmentOP. The group PLaggregate cannot be relabeled as a single realestate segment margin or used to reconcile individual and consolidated earnings without a disclosed bridge.

findings.observation: August7 states nochange to May15 full-year earningsguidance. The supplement separately revises standalone orderforecast components: civil public85000vs70000, private25000vs40000mJPY; civil total110000 and allorders total280000 are unchanged.
findings.interpretation_limit: Unchanged earningsforecast does not mean all company assumptions, ordercomposition or plans unchanged. The compositionrevision is not a revenue/profitrevision or an independently inferred demand/collectionforecast.

findings.observation: Annual consolidated nonoperating forecast excludes both group currencydifferences and Ishikari FXforwardvaluation effects. Individual forecast note excludes the company’s currencydifferences. Actual currentQ1 includes FXforwardvaluation gain1463mJPY in nonoperatingincome; priorQ1 shows FXforwardvaluation loss1176mJPY.
findings.interpretation_limit: Unmodeled forecast exposure is not a prediction of zero or nonrecurrence. Currentgain is not a currentloss. Do not add the gain mechanically to annual issuerguidance, carry it forward, annualize it, or addback all historical currencylosses. Cash/valuation/settlement/tax/time paths and any sensitivities remain unestablished.

findings.observation: CurrentQ1 consolidated dividendincome923mJPY and FXforwardvaluationgain1463mJPY are nonoperating. Securities-salegain304mJPY is specialprofit, fixedassetdisposalloss425mJPY specialloss. Priorperiod securitiesvaluationloss6mJPY versus current dash is not a newly disclosed current impairmentloss. Overseaslarge-project loss and Ishikari lowutilization/maintenance appear in operatingbusiness explanations without separately disclosed addback amounts here.
findings.interpretation_limit: Do not move receiveddividends, specialprofits/losses or an assumed impairment intoOP. Do not set dash tozero in financial inputs or turn an unexplained cost into a verified oneoff. Taxes/noncontrolling interests and dividend distributions remain separate from revenue/OP, so a nonoperating gain is not a one-for-one parentNI orEPS uplift.

findings.observation: Q1 consolidated CF is explicitly not prepared. Disclosed D&A880mJPY versus742mJPY includes intangible amortization and is a quarter note.
findings.interpretation_limit: This note is neither CFO norFCFF and does not establish capex/workingcapital/cash settlement. A reply confirming the definition cannot fill a complete cashflow model or add depreciation twice.

findings.observation: The reportedJune-quarter issued/treasury/weightedaverage shares and employeebenefittrust exclusions are explicit. The company separately states July15 resolution/July31 restricted-stock-remuneration treasuryshare disposal is considered in forecastDPS and annualEPS.
findings.interpretation_limit: The laterJuly transaction is not a June30 actualsharecount. Do not replace annualforecast sharebasis with JuneQ1average, deduce an undisclosed futuredenominator, reapply disposal on top of the issuer’s stated forecast or extend300JPY DPS into a future dividendstream. These disclosed notes do not quantify the annual averagefuturepath.

findings.observation: The August7 statement reports a nonrecourse-loan covenantbreach at Ishikari, a parent additionalloan contract for liquiditysupport, and no lender exercise of acceleration-relatedrights.
findings.interpretation_limit: This is the disclosure’s dateddescription, not verifiedresolution or October15 status. Noexercise does not establish waiver/remediation/riskzero; parentcontract is not a quantified completedcashtransfer or fullparentguarantee. No maturity/amount/condition/sensitivity is invented.

reply_interpretation_constraints.nature: Project application of the cited meaning boundaries; no new authorinvestment rule or numeric threshold.

items.rule: A reply clarifying a publicdefinition/column/accountingcategory can update the research explanation after public-information review; it does not itself change a profitforecast, valuation multiple, target or investmentaction.

Treat an issuer plan revision as a new dated publicforecast, preserving priorvintage, period, consolidation and exclusions. The two stated FXexclusions do not create a numerical replybranch or zero futureFXinput.

An answer about scope or occurrence of loss/maintenance does not supply a permitted amount, recurrenceassumption or OPaddback unless these are explicitly source-backed and separately reviewed. PublicPL classification cannot be overruled by an informal normalisation label.

Keep answerasof dates; confirmation of July31 treatment or August7 noacceleration is not a fresh futuredenominator, new dividendschedule, or proof of current financingresolution. Require later publicevidence for later state.

publicly_resolved_without_new_IR_draft: Five-segment recast of priorQ1 and separateaggregatePLnames.
Dated earningsforecast unchanged, specificFXexclusions, ordermix revision rather than blanket unchangedplans.
ReportedQ1 nonoperating/special classifications and noncontrollingprofit distinction.
Quartertrustshares and July31disposal reflected in forecastEPS/DPS.
remaining_public_dependencies: Publicforecast revisions and results afterAugust7; no nextrelease date established.
Public explanations of currencyvaluation versus settlement/taxes/time exposure; not a selfgenerated sensitivity.
Any later quantified scope/recurrence evidence for projectloss/maintenance and fresh covenant/funding status.

（インフラ運営事業等）
 インフラ運営事業等は再生可能エネルギーによる発電・売電事業等で、前年同期間において商業運転を停止してい
た連結子会社である石狩バイオエナジー（同）が運転を再開したことにより、売上高は前年同期間に比べ376.4％増加
した1,366百万円となりました。損益面においては、同社は商業運転を再開したものの、稼働率が低調であったことに
加え、一部設備において追加のメンテナンス費用が発生したことから、営業損失は1,477百万円（前年同期間は585百
万円の営業損失）となりました。

quotations.quote:
２．報告セグメントの変更等に関する事項
  当社グループは、2030年に向けたビジョンにおいて、「持続的な成長に向け事業領域を拡大し、強固な収益基
 盤を築く」の実現を掲げており、新事業開発と不動産事業を通じた事業領域の拡大及び収益基盤の強化を加速さ
 せるため、当第１四半期連結会計期間の期首から当社グループ内の組織体制を変更しています。
  組織体制の変更に併せて業績管理区分を見直し、従来「投資開発事業」に区分していた不動産の販売及び賃貸
 に関する事業及び再生可能エネルギーによる発電・売電事業等をそれぞれ「不動産事業」及び「インフラ運営事
 業等」に区分を変更しています。
  さらに、従来「その他」に区分していた建設資機材等の製造及び販売に関する事業等について、今後の事業展
 開を踏まえ、報告セグメントとして記載する方法に変更しており、名称を「機械事業」としています。
  その結果、「土木事業」「建築事業」「投資開発事業」の３区分としていた報告セグメントを、「土木事業」
 「建築事業」「不動産事業」「インフラ運営事業等」「機械事業」の５区分に変更しています。各報告セグメン
 トの概要は以下のとおりです。
  土木事業：土木工事その他建設工事全般に関する事業
  建築事業：建築工事その他建設工事全般に関する事業
  不動産事業：不動産の販売及び賃貸に関する事業
  インフラ運営事業等：再生可能エネルギーによる発電・売電事業等
  機械事業：建設資機材等の製造及び販売に関する事業等
  なお、前第１四半期連結累計期間のセグメント情報については、変更後の報告セグメントの区分に基づき作成
 したものを記載しています。
